# Governance

ORCA is maintained by the repository maintainers and contributors. Maintainers are responsible for reviewing contributions, protecting users, managing releases, and resolving project-policy questions.

## Decision making

Maintainers seek consensus through issues and pull requests. When consensus cannot be reached, the maintainers make the final decision after considering technical merit, user impact, maintainability, security, and project scope.

## Contributions

Anyone may propose changes by opening an issue or pull request. Maintainers may request revisions, decline changes that do not fit the project, or ask for additional testing and documentation.

## Maintainer changes

Maintainers may be added or removed by agreement of the existing maintainers. Significant governance changes should be discussed publicly before adoption.
